episode_title: 196: Parliament refurb, Power tools and Persimmon’s recycling

real_qa.q: What are the cost and timeline estimates for the Palace of Westminster full decant refurbishment option?
real_qa.r: The full decant option was costed at 3.5 billion pounds 10 years ago and is now estimated to cost up to 11.5 billion pounds over 19 to 24 years. If spread over that timeframe, it would cost approximately 490 million pounds per year on average.
real_qa.requete: Palace of Westminster refurbishment cost 11.5 billion

real_qa.q: Why has the Palace of Westminster enhanced maintenance and improvement option become more expensive than the full decant option?
real_qa.r: The stay-put option with builders working around MPs, costed at 5.7 billion pounds 10 years ago, is now estimated at 18.7 billion pounds—more than three and a half times the cost increase in a decade. It would also take 45 years to complete, making it effectively never-ending in practical terms, averaging 310 million pounds per year.
real_qa.requete: Palace of Westminster EMI option cost 18.7 billion 45 years

real_qa.q: What specific infrastructure problems affect the Palace of Westminster that require urgent refurbishment?
real_qa.r: The building suffers from insanitary and unhygienic conditions, fire risks, asbestos contamination, rats and mice infestations, deteriorated pipework, and flooded basements. These structural and safety issues are being addressed only through emergency maintenance patches rather than comprehensive solutions.
real_qa.requete: Palace of Westminster structural problems asbestos fire risk

real_qa.q: What alternative building has been proposed to replace the Palace of Westminster as the Houses of Parliament?
real_qa.r: Buckingham Palace has been proposed as a potential new parliamentary building. The Palace is reportedly disliked by the current King, and Windsor Castle and Kensington Palace complex provide the Royal family with other residences, making Buckingham Palace available for repurposing as an equally grand and symbolic parliamentary building.
real_qa.requete: Buckingham Palace new Houses of Parliament alternative

real_qa.q: When was the Palace of Westminster originally built and by which architects?
real_qa.r: The existing buildings were constructed between 1840 and 1870. Charles Barry was the principal architect responsible for the overall design and structure, while Augustus Pugin designed and executed the interior furnishings and Gothic decorative elements. Westminster Hall, a medieval structure, remains at the foundation of the complex.
real_qa.requete: Palace of Westminster Charles Barry Pugin 1840-1870

real_qa.q: How has GenPower improved the JCB Power Tools range after acquiring the licensing rights?
real_qa.r: GenPower, a British family business based in Pembrokeshire, Wales, spent two years in research and development perfecting the JCB branded 18-volt cordless power tools. The company claims the new range is now competitive with professional-grade tools from manufacturers like Makita, Bosch, and Milwaukee by upspeccing the product and working with specialized global manufacturers with dedicated quality control oversight.
real_qa.requete: GenPower JCB Power Tools Pembrokeshire rebranding
